title: ClearLookAt - Actor
content:
Member of: Actor Script

Clears this actor's script-forced look-at target.

Syntax:
Function ClearLookAt() native

Parameters:
None.

Return Value:
None.

Examples:
; Clear the stalker's look at target
Stalker.ClearLookAt()

See Also:
- Actor Script
- SetLookAt - Actor
